about: The webship-js extra-steps packs (@webship-js/<name>-steps) the Webship Workspace knows. cmd-tools-testing.sh --list-steps and the dashboard's Extra steps panel ask npm for the packs (cached for a day) and use this list when npm cannot be reached. What each pack is comes from here either way: kind is platform (a site with its own address and accounts: two never share a cucumber.js profile), extension (it builds on its base and goes in the same profile) or any-site (it goes beside any pack). detect lists what on a front page suggests the pack (a generator meta tag, an X-Powered-By header, an asset, a piece of the HTML): it is printed as a suggestion, never installed. Titles, summaries and logos are the ones of the docs cards on webship.co. version is the last release known when this list was written.
